description: Replace a LinkedIn company page's logo, as one of your connected accounts (account_id): send image_url, a public https address of a PNG or JPEG, or upload the file as multipart field image. A square picture of 400 by 400 or more works best. -- MakeHybrid API plan, POST /linkedin/pages/{company_id}/logo, group pages.

company_id.description: Value for the {company_id} segment of /linkedin/pages/{company_id}/logo. Required; pass it raw (it is URL-escaped for you).

query.description: Optional query-string parameters, e.g. {"limit":"20","cursor":"..."}. Values are coerced to strings.
